treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — insurance penetration rate using insurance statistics. Deliverable: baseline report. treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 30 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >7 consecutive days, escalate to a fixed income and credit market specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign.
